description: This file implements a notes cache module for managing notes associated with objects in a git repository, including initializing, reading, writing, and updating notes.

methods.name: void notes_cache_init(struct repository * r,struct notes_cache * c,const char * name,const char * validity)
methods.description: Initializes a notes cache for a given repository and reference, setting up the validity and note tree.

methods.name: int notes_cache_write(struct notes_cache * c)
methods.description: Writes the current notes cache to disk, creating a new commit and updating the ref if the cache is dirty.

methods.name: char * notes_cache_get(struct notes_cache * c,struct object_id * key_oid,size_t * outsize)
methods.description: Retrieves the note associated with a specific object ID from the cache, returning its data.

methods.name: int notes_cache_put(struct notes_cache * c,struct object_id * key_oid,const char * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Associates data with a specific object ID in the notes cache, writing it as a note object.

methods.name: int notes_cache_match_validity(struct repository * r,const char * ref,const char * validity)

ctags.signature: (struct repository * r,struct notes_cache * c,const char * name,const char * validity)
